statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-70190 is a .NET SDK elevation of privilege issue: the elevated SDK workload installer can follow a junction or symbolic link under %ProgramData%\dotnet. Microsoft lists Windows as the only affected platform and .NET SDK 10.0.100 through 10.0.112 as affected, fixed in 10.0.113 (https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/463, https://github.com/dotnet/sdk/issues/56612, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.13/10.0.13.md). The elevated installer is the MSI-based workload installer: the SDK selects it only for MSI installs and throws an error instead when the operating system is not Windows (https://github.com/dotnet/dotnet/blob/v10.0.112/src/sdk/src/Cli/dotnet/Commands/Workload/Install/WorkloadInstallerFactory.cs). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux, and the .NET SDK it ships in dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap is built for Linux (linux-musl), so dotnet workload commands use the file-based installer and the elevated Windows installer path is not reached. Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0, 10.0.3-r0, 10.0.4-r0, 10.0.5-r0, 10.0.6-r0, 10.0.7-r0, 10.0.8-r0, 10.0.9-r0, 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold: none of them contains a native Windows PE file. For reference, the bootstrap SDK is 10.0.102 to 10.0.110 in 10.0.2-r0 to 10.0.10-r0 and 10.0.113 or later from 10.0.13-r0 on.

CVE-2026-70190 is a .NET SDK elevation of privilege issue: the elevated SDK workload installer can follow a junction or symbolic link under %ProgramData%\dotnet. Microsoft lists Windows as the only affected platform (https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/463, https://github.com/dotnet/sdk/issues/56612, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/9.0/9.0.21/9.0.21.md). The elevated installer is the MSI-based workload installer: the SDK selects it only for MSI installs and throws an error instead when the operating system is not Windows (https://github.com/dotnet/sdk/blob/v9.0.122/src/Cli/dotnet/commands/dotnet-workload/install/WorkloadInstallerFactory.cs). DHI dotnet9-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 9 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 242 packages of the eleven published builds (9.0.12-r0, 9.0.13-r0, 9.0.14-r0, 9.0.15-r0, 9.0.16-r0, 9.0.17-r0, 9.0.18-r0, 9.0.20-r0, 9.0.21-r0, 9.0.22-r0 and 9.0.23-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold: every build is a Linux SDK and runtime for x86_64 and aarch64, so dotnet workload commands use the file-based installer and the elevated Windows installer path is never reached in any published build.
